Name: Wait a second
Author: KorinDev
Description:
[size=5][i]Wait a Second...[/i]

[/size]...is a mod that lets you skip time by waiting.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ability to wait 1, 5 or 8 hours.
[*]Energy Penalty [u](configurable with GMCM)[/u]
[*]Option to only allow waiting if player is sitting [u](configurable with GMCM)[/u]
[/list]

[b]To-do:[/b][list]
[*]Add an item [u](clock that replaces the wait keybind / configurable with GMCM)[/u]
[*]...?
[/list]
[b][u]Not tested in MultiPlayer/Local Co-Op[/u][/b]

Manifest.Name: Wait a second
Manifest.Description: A mod that allows *waiting* while sitting
